blocker.summary: A factual Green Line reservation cannot be built without first making Huntington a divided road, and that moves every locked artefact of the canonical opening.
why: There is no median or reservation concept anywhere in the road system: no field, no band, no section support.
halfRoad is DERIVED from lane count: halfRoad = (lanes/2)*laneW + shoulder + park. Dropping Huntington from 4 lanes to 2 to free ~7 m of median takes halfRoad from 9.80 m to 6.30 m.
That moves the kerb line inward 3.5 m, and with it the footway, the graded W_VERGE crossing accepted in 35d56ae, and the parking lane whose offset (8.55 m) the starter SUV solver resolves against.
Holding halfRoad by overriding street width sets `lw`, which disables lane markings entirely (`marks = ... && !lw`) and replaces real lane centres with a naive division.
So a median needs NEW section capability in Roads.js - a reserved band that lane layout, parking and the kerb line all respect.
blocker.notATasteJudgement: The rails would otherwise sit under live traffic lanes at o = -3.5..+3.5, because the four travelled lanes are centred at -5.25, -1.75, +1.75 and +5.25.

waveCPrerequisite: Add a median/reservation band to the Roads section model, with lane layout and parking derived AROUND it rather than across it.
Keep halfRoad and the kerb line fixed at 9.80 m so the footway, the graded crossing and the parking lane do not move.
Then lay two tracks on the corridor centre - which is already the real reservation centre - and the two staggered side platforms above.
